Specification of Platform Health Management
AUTOSAR AP R23-11
C Platform Extension API (normative)
The focus of the APIs in this section are for OEM-specific platform extensions. The
abstraction of the interfaces is lower which could lead to a higher machine dependency.
C.1 WatchdogInterface
This chapter lists the required APIs for PHM to interact with the hardware watchdog.
